svg.title: Mosaic layouts
svg.desc: Six, nine or eighteen phones form the Solana logomark in three rows, one row per bar. Six and nine phones lie in landscape; eighteen stand in portrait. Every phone shows a fragment of the same physical size: the narrowest usable width and the shortest usable height among the phones.
svg.text: Three rows, one per bar: row seams fall in the gaps between bars. Every phone shows a fragment of the same physical size.
Every fragment ≥ 45% filled; red marks are sealed seams
Outer phones carry the slanted bar ends (8–30% filled)
Fragment: 58 × 128 mm, the narrowest usable width and
the shortest usable height. No single phone has this shape.
